generate_tensorboard_log_root: generate a timestamped TensorBoard log root directory path using the TENSORBOARD_LOG_DIR environment variable
get_metrics_writer_benchmarker: get a TensorBoardWriter for benchmark metrics with data_split prefix fields and training event step tracking
get_metrics_writer_learner: get a TensorBoardWriter for learner train or eval metrics scoped to a specific training event index
get_metrics_writer_finetuning: get a TensorBoardWriter for finetuning metrics with training event step tracking
get_metrics_writer_with_overrides: get a TensorBoardWriter for learner metrics with optional override key-value pairs appended to the log directory
